How to Use This App

Getting Around

Use the bottom navigation bar to move between tabs:

🗺️ Map · ✅ Attendance · 🚨 Safety · ⚠️ Hazard · 📚 Modules · 💬 Messages · 📊 Overview (instructor/admin only) · 👤 Profile

🗺️ Map

Check the Weather and Earthquake monitors for automatic alerts, view the Community Map for hazard zones, and tap "Current Location" to refresh your GPS. Instructors/admins also see a live list of student locations here.

✅ Attendance

Tap Time In when you arrive and Time Out when you leave — you must be near campus with GPS on. No signal? Tap anyway; it saves offline and syncs automatically later. If GPS fails, your instructor can scan the QR code on your physical TUP ID card as a backup.

🚨 Safety

Tap any hotline to auto-call it. Tap the big red SOS button to send an emergency alert with your location. Use the shortcuts below it for Hazard Report, First Aid, Flashlight, and Share Location. Admins/instructors can also Send Alert to All Users and view SOS History.

⚠️ Hazard

Tap the map to pin a hazard location (or use your GPS), choose a type, add a description and optional photo, then submit. View your own reports under "My Reports," and browse community reports as a List, Heat Map, or Trends chart.

📚 Modules

Browse course materials linked via Google Drive. Instructors can add new units and attach activities (quizzes/assignments) to them.

💬 Messages

Chat in your auto-assigned Group Chat based on your college/course. Instructors can post to the Instructor Message broadcast channel and send Announcements to all students.

📊 Overview (instructor/admin)

Tap Refresh All Campuses for a live snapshot of weather, seismic activity, safety, and student counts across every campus.

👤 Profile

Update your info, enable Notifications, save an Emergency Contact, change your password, or download the Data Privacy Consent Form.

Tip: If a feature isn't working, check that GPS, camera, and notification permissions are allowed for this app in your device settings.
